name: Ghost Train Haze
summary: **Ghost Train Haze** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:Rare Dankness]] founder Scott Reach in Colorado, with seeds first shared around 2011. A cross of [[ghost-og|Ghost OG]] and [[nevils-wreck|Nevil's Wreck]], it takes its name from its Ghost OG parent. It won top U.S. sativa at the 2014 Cannabis Cup in Denver.
